taskGoal: Implement the V3.10 Flyway migration, schema-signature, H2 backup/recovery, and PostgreSQL acknowledgement chain with focused verification.
actualChanges: Added the V3.9 entity-derived V1 baseline and nullable V2 ai_providers.secret_ref migration; Flyway is the release schema owner while baselineOnMigrate remains false.
Added exact bounded schema inspection for tables, columns, type families, nullability, primary keys, unique constraints, indexes, and foreign keys, with frozen V3.9 and known-current classifications.
Added H2 BACKUP TO archives with checksummed complete manifests, atomic artifact moves, bounded retention, tamper validation, and isolated restore without an automatic database switch.
Added fail-closed Flyway preflight for empty, known V3.9, current-history, unknown legacy, unsupported dialect, invalid baseline configuration, and PostgreSQL backup acknowledgement paths.

Raised the backend dependency baseline to Spring Boot 3.5.15 and pinned the requested framework/runtime/security dependency floors; SCIP protobuf, Guava, and Testcontainers commons-compress are directly managed at safer versions.

verification.build: mvn -B -DskipTests package passed; main and test sources compiled.
verification.tests: Focused migration suite passed: 13 tests, 0 failures before the final H2 index-name canonicalization; the final DatabaseSchemaSignatureTest reran 4 tests with 0 failures. PostgreSQL Testcontainers fixture compiled and was skipped because PROJECTFLOW_RUN_POSTGRES_MIGRATION_TESTS was not enabled.
